---
title: "Batch Effect & Integration"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/tables.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- get_result_dir("data")
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)
batch_summary <- read_summary_for_step(result_dir, manifest, "batch_check")
integration_summary <- read_summary_for_step(result_dir, manifest, "integration")
```

## Batch Check

```{r batch-status, results='asis'}
if (is.null(batch_summary)) {
  cat("Batch check summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", batch_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Plots: ", batch_summary$metrics$plot_count %||% 0))
}
```

```{r batch-plots, fig.cap="Pre-integration batch check plots", out.width="48%"}
if (!is.null(batch_summary)) display_images(result_dir, batch_summary, max_images = 12)
```

## Integration

```{r integration-status, results='asis'}
if (is.null(integration_summary)) {
  cat("Integration summary not available.")
} else {
  cat(paste0("Status: **", integration_summary$status, "**  "))
  cat(paste0("Method: ", integration_summary$metrics$integration_method %||% manifest$integration_method))
}
```

```{r integration-plots, fig.cap="Post-integration diagnostics", out.width="48%"}
if (!is.null(integration_summary)) display_images(result_dir, integration_summary, max_images = 12)
```

## Integration Artifacts

```{r integration-artifacts}
artifacts <- artifact_table(integration_summary)
if (nrow(artifacts) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(artifacts[, intersect(c("type", "path", "bytes"), colnames(artifacts)), drop = FALSE], format = "html")
} else {
  cat("No integration artifacts recorded.")
}
```
